scored: The findings the adapter writes for each configuration (findings.mjs in engine mode), matched and scored by the benchmark's own matcher and scorer with Claude Sonnet 5.
reported: Grounded precision, recall and F1 on all severities, on high and medium severity, and on high severity, for all 219 pull requests.
The same for the 164 pull requests outside the test set and the fresh sample. No earlier run of this project reviewed them.
reused: The 55 pull requests reviewed earlier keep their first saved answer for each kind of pass.
failures: A review that fails three times is run again later. A pull request with no answer after that counts with zero findings.
